import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

NS = {
    'm': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
}

path = 'sales_data.xlsx'
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    print("=== Zip entries ===")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(n)

    # workbook.xml -> sheets and relationships
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    print("\n=== Sheets ===")
    sheets = []
    for s in wb.find('m:sheets', NS):
        sheets.append((s.get('name'), s.get('sheetId'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')))
        print(s.attrib)

    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rel_map = {}
    for rel in rels:
        rel_map[rel.get('Id')] = rel.get('Target')
    print("\n=== Rel map ===")
    for k, v in rel_map.items():
        print(k, v)

    # shared strings
    sst = None
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        sst_root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        sst = [''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')) for si in sst_root]
        print("\n=== Shared strings (first 30) ===")
        for i, s in enumerate(sst[:30]):
            print(i, repr(s))

    # dump each sheet xml
    for name, sid, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map.get(rid)
        if target.startswith('/'):
            target = target[1:]
        else:
            target = 'xl/' + target
        print(f"\n=== Sheet XML: {name} -> {target} ===")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            cells = []
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', NS)
                val = v.text if v is not None else None
                if t == 's' and val is not None:
                    val = sst[int(val)]
                cells.append((ref, t, val))
            print(cells)

            cells.append((c.get('r'), c.get('t'), c.get('s'), cell_val(c)))
        print(cells)

    print("\n=== styles.xml ===")
    st = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/styles.xml'))
    for child in st:
        print(child.tag.replace(M, ''), child.attrib)
    fonts = st.find(M + 'fonts')
    print("\nFonts:")
    for i, f in enumerate(fonts):
        print(i, ET.tostring(f, encoding='unicode'))
    fills = st.find(M + 'fills')
    print("\nFills:")
    for i, f in enumerate(fills):
        print(i, ET.tostring(f, encoding='unicode'))
    numfmts = st.find(M + 'numFmts')
    print("\nNumFmts:")
    if numfmts is not None:
        for f in numfmts:
            print(f.attrib)
    cellxfs = st.find(M + 'cellXfs')
    print("\nCellXfs:")
    for i, xf in enumerate(cellxfs):
        print(i, xf.attrib)

import zipfile
import re
import os
import shutil

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    names = zin.namelist()
    infos = {i.filename: i for i in zin.infolist()}
    sheet_xml = zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
    styles_xml = zin.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

# --- sheet1.xml edits ---
# 1. dimension
sheet_xml = sheet_xml.replace('<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>')
# 2. add column 8 definition
sheet_xml = sheet_xml.replace(
    '</cols>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>')

# 3. header cell H1
sheet_xml = sheet_xml.replace(
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
    '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin (%)</t></is></c></row>')

# 4. data rows 2..9 and total row 10
for n in range(2, 11):
    cell = f'<c r="H{n}" s="3"><f>G{n}/E{n}</f><v></v></c>'
    sheet_xml = re.sub(
        rf'(<row r="{n}">.*?)</row>',
        lambda m: m.group(1) + cell + '</row>',
        sheet_xml,
        count=1)

# --- styles.xml edits ---
styles_xml = styles_xml.replace(
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
styles_xml = styles_xml.replace(
    '<cellXfs count="3">',
    '<cellXfs count="4">')
styles_xml = styles_xml.replace(
    '</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>')

# --- write new zip preserving all other entries byte-for-byte ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w') as zout:
    for name in names:
        if name == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = sheet_xml.encode('utf-8')
        elif name == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = styles_xml.encode('utf-8')
        else:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
                data = zin.read(name)
        zout.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=infos[name].date_time), data, compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print("done")
